correctness.rationale: For a loopless independent-arc relation R with p_n=sqrt((2log n+c)/n), the G∘H and H∘G universal box operators correspond to R∘R^{-1} and R^{-1}∘R; equality on ALL subsets is exactly relation equality (witness by complement of one target). Off-diagonal relation entries equal common-successor and common-predecessor existence. For any fixed t distinct directional pair-defects, per outside vertex witness probability t p_n^2 +O_t(p_n^3) by inclusion-exclusion; independent outside z and bounded endpoint correction yield uniform joint event probability n^{-2t}e^{-tc}(1+o(1)). Since there are n(n-1) defect types, all factorial moments tend to e^{-tc}, hence Poisson(e^{-c}). Missing in/outdegree at any vertex has probability <=2n(1-p_n)^{n-1}=o(1), so diagonals cannot alter limit exp(-e^{-c}). Independently enumerated ALL loopless labelled directed graphs n=1,2,3,4 (1+4+64+4096 structures) and ALL valuations; verified relation-product/box equivalence and exact missing-pair means. Small cases do not prove the infinite law.
